1.0: You got the fourth Augury back. Did anything unusual happen in Riena? \r\n#L0##bI witnessed people who were once enemies gathering their powers to overcome difficult times. I intend to walk my own path of destiny as well.#l\n#k
1.1: Sounds like you learned quite a bit. More than I expected, anyway. I'm sure your future is bri...positive, Luminous. Now, this is the last Augury.
